content.bridge_context: Learning how 3D objects look from different angles and how they are made from 2D shapes.

units.title: Faces, Edges, and Vertices
units.explanation: Faces are flat surfaces. Edges are where faces meet. Vertices are corners.
units.dual_language_instruction: Count faces on a dice. / एक पासे पर फलकों (faces) को गिनें।

units.title: Nets for 3D Shapes
units.explanation: A net is a 2D skeleton that can be folded to form a 3D shape.
units.dual_language_instruction: Open a cardboard box to see its net. / कार्डबोर्ड बॉक्स को उसके नेट (net) देखने के लिए खोलें।
